I must say that I've only done the starter missions on Mercury and Earth, including some Venus ones. I'd say this a a great game. I have to admit that I thought this was bad before I played it, it took me a while to get used to wall running. It's controls are great, but with trouble, everything is balanced, and most of it relies on a good team, and not the brat that claims to be better. Overall Score:
9.5/10 Controls
10/10 Balance

Warframe is a good game overall!

[b]INTRODUCTION[/b]

Warframe is an awesome, very original, free-to-play title, You play as high-tech space ninjas, fighting on planets and spaceships. The game features randomly generated levels, addictive 3rd person combat, a lot of grinding and a very enjoyable sci-fi style. It is very suited to play with a small group of friends, as unlike most MMO's, even a small guild of 4-8 players is big enough to gain access to and finish all the content in the game. 



[b]PROS[/b]

- Extremely responsive and enjoyable combat. Shooting and melee slicing is fast, precise and feels very good.
- Graphically, it is a goodlooking game, it has a very original art style. The awesome looking space-ninjas, weapons and some parts of the randomly generated levels being most notable.
- Similarily, the weapons, melee and explosions all sound great. The enemies even use their own alien language, which does a lot for the atmosphere of the game.
- As a guild you can actually make your own base, which is a level on itself that you can walk through and do some fun (fluff) stuff in, as well as developing some special weapons and tech. (though it mostly functions as a place to meet your friends)
- You can do somersaults, slides, walljumps and various movement tricks. This almost makes Warframe an actual freerunning game too. Everything can actually be used in combat as well, which adds a lot of flair to the game.
-  It can be very challenging to play (if you choose so), or very casual, relaxing. The difficulty is very scaleable.
- There are loads of cool things in the game worth getting. This makes it so you can spend a ton of time playing if you choose to; gathering materials, crafting new weapons, warframes and items.
- All the different warframes have unique playing styles and the game allows for a lot of variation and customized builds. The skills each warframe has are unique, very powerful and as such, essential to get you through the most challenging parts of the game.
- The free-to-play model is very fair, it is really not required to buy anything in the game, though it can speed you up immensely if you do. (plus it is nice to be able to support the team that made warframe)


[b]CONS[/b]

- The networking code can be a bit of a problem as the hosting is done by players, which can have a bad connection and cause lag. This is never an issue if you host yourself, unless your computer can't run warframe at a consistant framerate, in which case it will lag for everyone.
- The game is a bit of a performance hog, it won't run well on older computers. If you host, it becomes a lot worse, because of enemy A.I. being performance taxing as well. (the loads of enemies in multiplayer games doesn't help)
- Though the maps and missions are (almost always) randomly generated, the tilesets used are not. They tend to get old after a while and leads to less replayability.
- A few specific items (mainly reactors and catalysts) are harder to come by, but essential to max out your warframe or weapon. It can be frustrating to get these (without paying actual money in the store), as you often have to get lucky or wait a long time to get a chance to get one. This is as far as I know the only questionable decision made concerning their free-to-play model.


[b]END VERDICT[/b]

I am overwhelmingly positive about this title. The "cons" I mention are relatively minor, especially to a new player. They mostly start playing up if you played a couple of hundred hours, not before. That said though, I have to warn that you do need a good computer to play warframe. But if that's not an issue, most of this game's downsides only start to matter after playing a long, long time. Which for a free to play title, is a good place to be in. 

On a scale of 1 to 10 I give this a solid 9, highly recommended, good stuff!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

This is officially one of the best games I have ever played! 
One reason I didn't like Team Fortress 2 was that when playing online, the really good players kill you every time you spawn because they have special equipment. 
In this game, players work together in small teams to complete a wide variety of missions. 
In addition, every month or so the developers add a new operation with its own story line, or completely redesign a game mechanic that makes the game feel brand new!
I really love this game! the graphics and gameplay is amazing I also love the how each warframe has a very unique ability that they can use! keep it up! :D
